CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(Planned_Check_Date__c), "⚪ Not Scheduled",
IF( TODAY() < Start_Date__c, "🔵 Upcoming – Execution starts in " & TEXT(Start_Date__c - TODAY()) & " days",
IF( TODAY() > Due_Date__c, "🔴 Overdue by " & TEXT(ABS(Due_Date__c - TODAY())) & " days",
IF( TODAY() = Due_Date__c, "🕒 Due Today",
IF( Due_Date__c - TODAY() <= 14, "🟠 Due Soon – " & TEXT(Due_Date__c - TODAY()) & " days remaining",
"🟢 Execution Window Open – " & TEXT(Due_Date__c - TODAY()) & " days remaining" ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Planning Status
